title: Scheduled broadcasts and contact groups in Hyper Personalization
summary: Scheduled broadcasts and contact groups in Hyper Personalization, more subtitle formats, INR pricing and an auditable credit ledger.

sections.title: Hyper Personalization
sections.note: Hyperlocal is now Hyper Personalization. Your pages and links work as before.

items.body: Schedule a broadcast, then pause, resume or stop it
One filter for the contact list and the broadcast audience
Export DFXP, STL, EDL, XML, TXT and JSON alongside SRT and VTT
Line breaks and styling inside cues reach every export
Publish subtitles into up to 20 languages at once
Plans and top-ups show INR prices beside USD
Filter the credit ledger and export all of it as CSV
Editing a dub inside the editor is free
The balance pill warns when credits run low
Chat: Claude models now in the picker, plus the latest GPT and Gemini
Playground: translate an image into several languages
A new **Support** item in the nav rail
Pages load once instead of twice
Editors and members can open the Credits page
Running out of credits on a broadcast offers **Top up**
Charts and waveforms follow the theme
